info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Interviews-v4-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Interview Retrieval API provides a mechanism to access and view interview data related to job applications. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about interviews for various career applications, facilitating the assessment of candidates' progress in the hiring process. Typical consumers include HR professionals and recruitment teams who need to manage and review interview schedules and results efficiently. With this API, users can enhance their workflow and make informed hiring decisions based on interview insights.

get.description: Fetch a list of interview applications submitted by candidates. This endpoint allows you to view all relevant details about each application, making it easier to manage and track interviews.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about an interview application. The client must provide the necessary parameters in the JSON format to receive relevant data.

201.description: The request was successful and a new interview application resource has been created.
